course.title: Science (PCMB) 11th - PRARAMBH PLUS 2.0 ( 2026-27)
course.description:
PRARAMBH Plus Class 11th Science – A Year-Long Live Interactive Course designed to help you excel in your Class 11 Exams (2026–27).

  1. We will cover Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology, Physical Education and English/Hindi for Class 11 Science students.
  2. All classes will be conducted live and interactively. If you miss any session, recordings will be available on the Next Toppers App.
  3. Classes will be scheduled according to your school timings for your convenience.
  4. There will be 2 classes per day, each of 1 to 1.5 hours.
  5. A 45-day Crash Course (Nirbhay 2026–27) is included in this batch for final exam preparation.
  6. A weekly schedule will be provided in advance.
  7. Class notes in PDF format will be provided after each class on the Next Toppers App.
  8. Regular tests will be conducted to track your progress and improvement.
  9. You will have full access to the entire course until your final exams (2026–27).
  10. Physical Education, English/Hindi will be provided in recorded format, so you can study at your own convenience.
  11. This batch is non-refundable and non-transferable.
